parameters.content:
## CARD 1: ⚠️ RISK INTELLIGENCE AGENT
Deterministic risk aggregator across all child verification agents.
Identifies statutory, financial, forensic, experience, identity, and execution risk signals without arbitrary AI hallucination.

## CARD 2: ⚙️ DETERMINISTIC SCORING RULES
Mathematical scoring breakdown:
• NOT_VERIFIED: +40 pts (DOMAIN_RISK)
• SYSTEM_ERROR: +40 pts (SYSTEM_ERROR_RISK)
• NOT_EXECUTED: +40 pts (EXECUTION_RISK)
• HIGH residual: +30 pts | MEDIUM: +15 pts
• Low confidence (<0.70): +20 pts | Medium: +10 pts
• Score ceiling capped strictly at 100 points
